text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, just as we're about to start a meeting in my office…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have a special favor to ask of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's about an upcoming scrimmage. I would like to join.
choice_data_list: Are you sure? You've got a big race coming up.
Are you sure? You've got a big race coming up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Rest assured, I won't fail. I fully intend to triumph in both.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's why I'd like your permission. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, I decide to respect Yaeno Muteki's strong conviction…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your guidance today! Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From then on, Yaeno Muteki takes off the second we finish training each day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, however, I'm given a good reason to believe she's hiding something from me. I'm heading back to the academy after finishing some errands in town, when…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hyaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing a fierce shout, I follow the sound to find Yaeno Muteki training alone in her signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Ah, as I thought. I suspected the approaching presence might be yours.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I apologize for training outside of our scheduled routine. I just… I want to push my body and mind to their very limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't afford the slightest risk of losing the upcoming scrimmage, no matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A few days ago, you see, I got a written challenge.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It said, "After observing you run recently, I have judged you a worthy adversary whose defeat will bring honor to my name."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Meet me at the upcoming scrimmage so we may determine who is the stronger between us."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As a student of the Yaegaki style, I cannot ignore such a challenge. It must be met with unwavering resolve.
choice_data_list: But… will your body hold out?
But… will your body hold out?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You needn't worry. This racewear fills my entire body with vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And that's because it is, in essence, proof of my credentials.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Only G1 racers are permitted to wear signature racewear. Defeat one such runner, and your name will rise in an instant. It's a proof of strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I believe that, in Kongo Yaegaki terms, attaining it is the equivalent of being recognized at a professional level.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Weakness is no longer permitted at that point. You must protect those important to you at all times, as well as the helpless and your own pride.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The more advanced students run through the mountains at night, split wood with their bare hands, hurl immense boulders, and herald the dawn with a thousand strikes of the great bell—all while remaining calm and composed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No matter how tough the situation, your strength mustn't waver. That is what it means to be a student of the Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In the same vein, for as long as I wear this outfit, I intend to be a powerful force who won't lose to anyone—not even myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Therefore, even if I'm challenged again in the future, I refuse to back down. I will use each challenge as an opportunity to display the strength of the Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, I beg of you—please allow this unworthy student to pursue her wish.
choice_data_list: Show them the strength of one who wears signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! Let the tempering continue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Yaeno Muteki continues her training. She brings her mind, body, and technique into perfect harmony, and she enters the scrimmage…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're on the homestretch! Yaeno Muteki is moving up the pack! She's slipped into the lead! And… it's Yaeno Muteki crossing the finish three lengths ahead of the next runner!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Student
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Her raw power was overwhelming! Though the racer in second did manage to hold out till the end!

text_block_list.name: Cogent Student
text_block_list.text: No… She saw through the flow of the race and her opponent's movements as if she was looking through clear water. She achieved victory like a true master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Challenger
text_block_list.text: Impressive. You were a step ahead in every aspect. I'll need to rethink my training methods.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Your challenge was the impetus for my growth, so please accept my deepest thanks.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And thank you for bearing witness, Trainer. Do you think I was able to fully demonstrate the spirit of the Kongo Yaegaki style?
choice_data_list: I caught a glimpse of the strength of the Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I believe this is all a manifestation of my daily efforts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And the reason I'm able to continue my daily training without an ounce of uncertainty is because I trust that the path I'm walking is right.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And that is all because I have sincere faith in the mentor who guides me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I will hold your teachings close to my heart and continue to dedicate myself to training. Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am delighted to hear that. To think that I've been able to demonstrate the source of my pride to you… This is a special feeling indeed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if I took a moment to speak about the Yaegaki style?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you… Ahem, let me begin by telling you about its origins…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find that the usually stern Yaeno Muteki becomes quite chatty when discussing the style she takes such pride in. A warm smile spreads across my face as I listen to her speak.
